entries.clue: Thirteen bearded questers who turned up at a hobbit's door for tea
Pastime invented at the Battle of the Green Fields when a head fell in a hole
Honey drink poured in the wooden hall of the man who turned into a bear
Spoken words left on an answering machine for someone who was out
Great birds that snatched the treed company out of the burning pines
Slinking underground creature with a boat, a fish diet and a lost ring
Sooty element, and the blackened paper that once doubled a typed letter
Vertical drop in a cave, rigged with rope or a wire ladder
Without pretence, and the word that ends a formal letter above your name
Mammoth tusk carved into figurines and left in Ice Age caves
Records-keeping employee, or the assistant serving at a bank window
Water-filled shaft in Yucatan rock, sacred to the Maya
Scenery of bare rock pavement, swallow holes and rivers that vanish
